title: Multi-Institutional Data Sharing Simulation
audience: Clinical learners exploring privacy-preserving hospital collaboration.
objectives: Detect and remove outliers before collaboration.
Impute and scale local clinical data consistently.
Run a federated-learning-style round without sharing patient records.

sections.name: Simulation Settings
sections.purpose: Choose scenario, sample size, and outlier contamination.

sections.name: Outlier Detection
sections.purpose: Use a z-score threshold to identify values for removal.

sections.name: Federated Learning Simulation
sections.purpose: Aggregate model weights instead of sharing raw patient data.

chatbot_guidance: Explain federated learning as sharing model updates, not raw patient records.
Guide learners to apply the outlier filter before later steps unlock.
Clarify why hospitals must preprocess consistently.
